items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: I think his last name was Chandler, was it?

ctx.x: Robichaux, yeah. He had a good drummer there too, boy. A little boy, a boy named, I don't know if his name wasn't Happy, they called him too. But that boy was a drummer, sure enough.
I think his last name was Chandler, was it? Yeah. Happy.
He used to play, he'd go, let me see. He went and played in, what do you call it?
